column1: IT  is  hereby  notified  that  by  virtue  of  powers  vested  in  me  under  Section  17  of  the  Customs  Ordinance  (Chapter  235)
I, P. S. M. Charles, Director General of Customs, determine that with effect  from 25th  November,  2019, all  duties of Customs
as well as  other charges,  penalties and forfeitures incurred under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235), shall be paid and
received at the Rates of Exchange set out in the Schedule.
The  notification  relating  to  the  Rates  of  Exchange  published  in  Gazette  Extraordinary,  No.  2150/1  of
18th  November,  2019 is  hereby rescinded  and  the said  Rates of  Exchange are Scheduled to be rescinded  by a similar
notification to be published on or before 01st  December, 2019.
